claims.text: Therapist guided CBT-I improves sleep onset latency in adults with primary insomnia, with benefits persisting at six-month follow-up.
Adherence to therapist guided CBT-I may decline among individuals with shift work schedules, limiting real-world effectiveness for this subgroup.
Findings from the cited CBT-I trial may not generalize to patients with comorbid depression because such patients were excluded.
Digital sleep interventions reproduce portions of therapist guided CBT-I but show more variable effects and less certain durability.
